title: Real-world throughput replay harness for tokens/sec regression detection
creator: Priya Kapoor
description: Background: Our existing microbench suites generate synthetic constant-rate streams that are valuable for steady-state throughput profiling but miss burst patterns and real-context prefix effects seen in customer traffic. Goal: Build a replay-based tokens/sec harness that can replay sampled production traces with preserved inter-request timing, payload diversity (short prompts, long prompts, multi-turn history), and configurable concurrency. This harness should produce stable tokens/sec curves, per-model p95 latency series, and automated regression alerts used by the CI/regression pipeline. The intention is not to replace synthetic probes but to complement them with a representative workload that uncovers regressions caused by KV cache behavior, batching inefficiencies, kernel scheduling, and cold-start tail effects.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Harness can ingest exported production trace captures (JSONL) and replay requests with original relative timing and a configurable time-scaling factor.
2) Support for sampling strategies: uniform, stratified by prompt length, and customer-weighted sampling.
3) For each run, produce: tokens/sec timeline (1s and 10s buckets), p95 latency time-series, per-model and per-instance breakdowns, and a regression score compared against a baseline run.
4) Integrated output stored to S3 and surfaced in the runtime-1.19 throughput dashboard; runs automatically created for nightly regression tests.
5) Alerting rule that fires when regression score > 6% overall or p95 shifts by > 12% for core model variants.
6) End-to-end test demonstrating detection of an injected 15% CPU regression on a canary model variant.
7) Documentation and runbook published (Confluence) and linked in CI jobs.
implementation_plan:
- Step 1: Trace format and sampling (Priya): define minimal JSONL schema and implement samplers (2d).
- Step 2: Replay engine (Ethan): implement timing-preserving scheduler with time-scaling, concurrency token bucket, and payload mutators to anonymize PII (4d).
- Step 3: Metrics collection: integrate with existing telemetry client to emit tokens/sec (1s/10s), per-request latencies, KV-cache hit markers (3d).
- Step 4: Regression comparator: compute normalized throughput score, p95 deltas, and bootstrap confidence intervals; implement small-batch bisect hook for automatic culprit isolation (3d).
- Step 5: CI integration and dashboard (SRE/Release): nightly job, S3 artifacts, and dashboard panel wiring (2d).
- Step 6: Validation: run against previous baselines and execute the injected-regression test (2d).
Notes: Keep replay harness language-agnostic (Python library + CLI) so it can be reused by on-prem teams. Use existing service auth for replay traffic and ensure rate limits of staging infra are respected.
progress_updates: 2025-02-14: Defined minimal trace JSONL schema v0.1 (timestamp, model, prompt_tokens, history_tokens, client_id_hash, kv_warmup_hint). Uploaded spec to Confluence: /confluence/bench/trace-schema.
2025-02-19: Implemented sampler module supporting uniform and length-stratified sampling. Initial sampling validated against production sample set (n=10k).

2025-02-25: Replay engine prototype completed (local mode). It preserves inter-request timing and supports time-scaling factor. Ran 1-minute replay against local mini-runtime; tokens/sec curve matches production slice when scaled.
2025-03-02: Telemetry hooks added: emits tokens_sec_1s, tokens_sec_10s, request_latency_ms, kv_cache_flag. Started wiring S3 artifact uploader for run results.

2025-03-04: Began regression comparator implementation. Prototype computes normalized throughput score by comparing cumulative tokens and bootstrapped confidence intervals. First alert threshold draft: 6% throughput / 12% p95.
comments: Daniel Ho (review): Please consider including a randomized jitter option for exact timing replay to avoid brittle scheduling interactions with infra-level batching. Also add an opt-in mode to tag replay runs so they do not affect production billing metrics.
Priya Kapoor: Added jitter param to replay engine (configurable, default 0.0). Billing-safe mode implemented: replay auth uses staging tenant and a replay tag header.
Maria Alvarez (SRE): For CI, make sure replay runs are rate-capped and can be run against dedicated canaries to avoid cross-customer interference. We can provide canary endpoints.
Ethan Liu: Working on bisect hook that can automatically split trace by client cohorts to help isolate regressions; initial algorithm uses recursive delta comparisons. Needs more tests.
